services.name: Seasonal RV Sites
services.desc: Welcome to long-term RV living at Strawberry Park! If you’re looking for a comfortable setup with a great community in southeastern Connecticut, you’ve landed in the right place. Choose a long-term full hookup site, reserve a seasonal spot, or explore our lease-to-own and for-sale lots for a path toward making Strawberry Park your go-to getaway each year. We’re really proud of the community at Strawberry Park. Long-term guests are a big part of what makes this place feel so welcoming and that’s exactly why we built this place with monthly and seasonal living in mind. Pull into a shaded, full hookup back-in site with a gravel pad, then get comfortable with the basics already covered,

services.name: Cabins
services.desc: Ever dreamed of spending the night in a log cabin? With eight cozy cabin rentals on property, we can make that happen! These humble abodes offer an easy way to enjoy campground life with a few extra comforts built in. Spend your days at the pools, participating in onsite activities, or exploring nearby attractions, then come back to your own space to relax. We can’t wait to host you. Our eight log cabins give you that classic cabin feel, with the comforts that make a trip just a little easier. Inside, each cabin includes a kitchen and bathroom, A/C, and a living area with a pullout sofa. Two bedrooms sleep the crew comfortably, one with a queen bed and one with twin bunks, plus a loft space
